clue.text: Comes to accept first people on the make

indicators.note: a word that accepts something takes it in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: comes means arrives
first is written 1ST, with the 1 read as the letter I

explanation.surface: A newcomer welcomes the first people who are out to get ahead.
explanation.walkthrough: The 1 of 1ST becomes an I, a common crossword convention for the numeral one.
explanation.definitionFit: Ambitious social climbers out for advancement are called by this French-derived term.

clue.text: A king — one in front of mob rioting with arms like this

parts.note: K is the chess and card abbreviation for king
the numeral one resembles the letter I

indicators.note: a rioting crowd is in disorder, so the word mob is scrambled

explanation.surface: A monarch stands before a rioting crowd, hands on hips.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in front of' simply puts the pieces in order.
explanation.definitionFit: Standing with hands on hips and elbows pointing outwards is the posture this adverb describes.

clue.text: Minister is member of board with first two members sacked

indicators.note: the first two letters, the opening members of the word, are dropped

parts.note: a member of a company board is a director

explanation.surface: A government minister is one of a board that has fired two of its members.
explanation.walkthrough: 'members' is a play: the first two letters, DI, are removed.
explanation.definitionFit: A parish priest in the Church of England is a minister of religion.

clue.text: Where one loses sight or night vision, nap restlessly

indicators.note: a restless sleeper tosses about, so these letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone sleeping fitfully loses their sight or night vision.
explanation.definitionFit: In perspective, parallel lines converge at the spot where they disappear from view.

clue.text: Sailor's handiwork and most of charisma developed in South-West

indicators.note: the developed letters go inside the abbreviation for the compass direction
developed means worked into a new form, so the letters are rearranged
most of means the word loses its final letter

explanation.surface: A sailor's craft shows charm grown up in the West Country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'most of' trims charisma to CHARISM; 'developed' rearranges that to CRIMSHA, which goes between S and W.
explanation.definitionFit: Carved and engraved whalebone or ivory was the traditional craft of whalers at sea.

clue.text: Throw out former pupil following exercise

indicators.note: the pupil comes after the exercise in the word

parts.note: ex means former
PE is physical exercise, physical education
L is the learner driver's plate, a pupil

explanation.surface: A school throws out a former student after a PE session.
explanation.definitionFit: To eject someone, say from school, is to force them to leave.

clue.text: Takes off, dismissing odd characters from, say, press

indicators.note: the first, third and other odd-placed letters are thrown away, keeping the even ones

explanation.surface: Someone removes strange people from, for example, the newspapers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'say' is part of the fodder, not a signal of an example.
explanation.definitionFit: To take someone off is to mimic or imitate them, as monkeys are said to copy.

clue.text: Fruit left worker in agony

indicators.note: the left-and-worker pieces sit inside the word for agony

parts.note: agony is pain
an ant is the crossword's usual worker insect

explanation.surface: A piece of fruit has left a labourer in great pain.
explanation.definitionFit: A starchy banana-like fruit usually cooked before eating.

clue.text: The cheapest accommodation is always accepted by coach

indicators.note: something accepted by another is taken inside it

parts.note: a stage is short for a stagecoach
e'er is the poetic contraction of ever, always

explanation.surface: Budget lodging is always taken by the coach company.
explanation.definitionFit: On passenger ships, the lowest-priced berths below decks were this class.

clue.text: Old hotel tonight — no different!

indicators.note: a different arrangement of these letters is wanted

explanation.surface: The ancient hotel looks no different tonight.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for aged, from a horse's gums receding with age.

clue.text: Popular preserve of a South American

parts.note: in means popular, fashionable
to can food is to preserve it

explanation.surface: A favourite jam belonging to someone from South America.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to the Andean empire's people, a South American civilisation.

clue.text: Half of profit being given in cashback is criminal

indicators.note: the half-word is placed in the middle of the other piece

parts.note: a rebate is money given back, cashback

indicators.note: the first half of the six-letter word is kept

explanation.surface: Skimming half the profit through refunds is against the law.
explanation.definitionFit: An unprincipled scoundrel or villain, a morally depraved person.

clue.text: Flourish, but seeing deprivation in return of Mafia

indicators.note: one piece is inserted in the turned-around mob
return means the word for the Mafia is read backwards

parts.note: the mob is the Mafia
deprivation is loss

explanation.surface: Someone thrives despite suffering hardship when the Mafia returns.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flourish' is the verb, to bloom; 'but seeing' only links the definition to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A verb: to develop well or thrive, as plants flower.

clue.text: Fire supplier that's not as serious

definitions.meaning: a device for producing a flame to light cigarettes
comparative of light, less weighty in tone

explanation.surface: Something that supplies fire is less grave.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is a flame-making gadget, the other the comparative of light meaning frivolous.

clue.text: Bearing and status

parts.note: with can mean and, as in tea with milk
standing is status or rank

explanation.surface: Deportment and social position.
explanation.definitionFit: Bearing in the sense of enduring or resisting a force.

clue.text: Girl mostly following sailor for protection

indicators.note: the name comes after the sailor

parts.note: tar is an old word for a sailor

indicators.note: mostly means the last letter of the name is dropped

parts.note: Pauline is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl trails a sailor, seeking his protection.
explanation.definitionFit: A heavy waterproof sheet used as a protective cover.

clue.text: Withdraw from event before end of relay, causing irritation

indicators.note: the withdrawal piece comes ahead of the final letter

parts.note: to scratch is to withdraw from a race or contest

indicators.note: end of means the last letter of the word is taken

explanation.surface: Pulling out just before the relay's final leg annoys teammates.
explanation.definitionFit: Rough fabric that prickles and itches the skin is so described.

clue.text: Sack everybody pinching women's online protection

indicators.note: pinching means holding tight, so the letter is gripped inside

parts.note: to sack is to fire
everybody is all
W is the abbreviation for women, as on doors

explanation.surface: Fire all staff who stole women's internet security.
explanation.definitionFit: Network software that blocks unauthorised access to a computer.

clue.text: Acutely embarrassing group in church value prayers at heart

indicators.note: the group goes inside the church abbreviation

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
a ring is a group, such as a criminal gang
worth is value

indicators.note: at heart takes the central letter of the word

explanation.surface: A church group values prayers deeply, to excruciating effect.
explanation.definitionFit: So awkward it makes one wince or shrink in shame.

clue.text: Primate's blessing coming after degree

definitions.note: read as primate is, the 's a link

parts.note: BA is a Bachelor of Arts degree
a boon is a blessing

explanation.surface: An archbishop's blessing comes after he gains his degree.
explanation.walkthrough: Primate looks like an archbishop; it is the ape family. 'coming after' orders the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A large African monkey with a dog-like muzzle is a member of this group of mammals.

clue.text: Leading actor emptied venue fast

parts.note: the leading actor is the star

indicators.note: emptied removes the inside, keeping only the outer letters

explanation.surface: The leading actor cleared the venue quickly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fast' reads as speed but is the verb, to go without food.
explanation.definitionFit: To go hungry, as in fasting, going without nourishment.

clue.text: Workers to return, joining a single plant

indicators.note: to return means the word is turned backwards

parts.note: men are workers, as in management and men
single means one

explanation.surface: Staff come back, joined by a lone plant.
explanation.definitionFit: A buttercup-family flower, also called a windflower.

clue.text: Bill supporting former lover's demand

indicators.note: in a down clue the supporting piece sits below the other

parts.note: an ex is a former lover
a bill becomes an act when passed by Parliament

explanation.surface: A bill backs up an ex-partner's demand.
explanation.definitionFit: To extract or insist on something, as in exacting a price.

clue.text: Tact and art redesigned as lure

indicators.note: redesigned means remade, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Diplomacy and artistry reworked make an enticement.
explanation.definitionFit: To draw in or entice, synonymous verbs.

clue.text: Reportedly man on range gets such protection

indicators.note: reportedly signals a word heard rather than seen

parts.note: a mountain range is a chain, and a man is a male, giving chain male

explanation.surface: A cowboy on the range is said to get armour.
explanation.definitionFit: Armour of interlinked metal rings protected medieval soldiers.

clue.text: Love stern reputation

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, the letter O
dour means stern

explanation.surface: Love has a stern reputation.
explanation.walkthrough: Reputation fits through the phrase in good or bad odour.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in good standing with someone is being in their good repute, an idiom.

clue.text: College porter going after the fourth of July

indicators.note: the beer comes after the picked letter
the fourth of picks the fourth letter of the month's name

parts.note: porter is a dark beer, an ale

explanation.surface: A college porter heads out after Independence Day.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the fourth of July' looks like the US holiday; it is the letter Y.
explanation.definitionFit: An Ivy League university in New Haven, Connecticut.

clue.text: Gun initially held by lunatic seen on the rocks

indicators.note: held by means placed inside the scrambled letters
lunatic means crazed, so the letters are mixed up
initially takes the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: A madman with a gun is spotted, drunk on whisky over ice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on the rocks' suggests drink; 'lunatic' rearranges SEENONTHE around G.
explanation.definitionFit: The prehistoric circle of standing stones on Salisbury Plain is a famous collection of rocks.
